method: Plan prices, credits and project caps read from the page's rendered text (monthly view) on 2026-10-16 and again on 2026-10-28, unchanged; the crawl-credit rules from Ahrefs' help centre. Not derived, not inferred from tier prices.
overage: Ahrefs' own FAQ: "Once you enable additional pay-as-you-go credits and data, you'll be automatically charged when consumption exceeds your plan's limits." So the credit figure is a threshold for billing as well as a cap, when pay-as-you-go is switched on.
not_claimed: Which tiers include Site Audit at all is NOT resolved here. Their feature grid uses no table rows and did not resolve per-tier; see competitors.csv's ahrefs-site-audit row, where the entry tier is recorded as unverified.
why_stored: A competitor's limits change without telling us. Dated here so the page quotes a reading rather than a memory, and so one edit updates every place that cites it.
